method: Whole-file manual reading of UI framework implementation, project filters and contributor document. Pinned bytes verified; project filters XML parsed.
findings: RunTaskWithUiUpdates executes synchronously off UI thread or without main window; otherwise launches jthread, captures exception, publishes completion with release/acquire, pumps messages, joins and rethrows. Per-call completion avoids using a shared completion message as the result itself.

Worker PostThreadMessage result is ignored. UI checks complete only before blocking GetMessage; a failed wake with otherwise idle queue can delay completion observation. No forced failure/runtime reproduction in this increment.

Nested task pump drops mouse/key/nonclient click messages, dispatches others directly without normal application preprocessing. WM_QUIT is remembered and reposted after join. GetMessage error breaks loop but then joins; no bounded shutdown guarantee.

WaitForHandleWithUiUpdates drains paint messages only and repeats the full timeout after each paint wake. Timeout is per wait iteration rather than a total wall-clock deadline; it returns void without distinguishing completion, timeout or failed wait.

Clipboard helper checks size overflow and frees memory on ownership-transfer failure, but EmptyClipboard occurs before allocation so subsequent failure can leave prior clipboard contents removed. No clipboard action executed.

Dialog-init resource parser uses bounded memcpy reads and string-terminator checks, remaps legacy list/combo add messages, rejects add failures. It can apply earlier entries before discovering a later malformed entry; no rollback transaction.

CenterWindow clamps origin to nearest monitor work area; oversized windows remain oversized. This supplies centering correction for callers using CenterWindow, but does not prove every persisted placement path does so.

Window-class registry caches names even when RegisterClassExW return is not checked. Project filters organize IDE display including generated language/license and contrib files; filters are not evidence those generated artifacts exist or compile. Contributor document read for attribution only.
limits: No Windows task-pump, failed wake, timeout, dialog resource, clipboard, window registration or centering runtime tests executed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
